note: APPROVED knowledge for Dental Hub. Deliberately small. An entry belongs here only if it is (a) directly evidenced in the audit workbook with a cited cell, (b) graded 'بيانات مؤكدة' (confirmed data), and (c) free of any commercial term — price, discount, warranty, instalment, delivery date — that Dental Hub has not confirmed in writing. Everything else is in knowledge.draft.json and is invisible to the model.

entries.title: قناة التواصل المعتمدة — واتساب
entries.body: رقم الواتساب المعلن على صفحة Dental Hub هو 01111772865. ده الرقم الرسمي للتواصل والاستفسار عن المنتجات وطلب عرض سعر.
entries.sourceCells: Reply Library r2; the number appears in RL-01, RL-03, RL-04, RL-19 and in the Comments Log suggested replies.
entries.evidence: Published by Dental Hub on the Facebook page itself. The audit states explicitly that the number used in the reply drafts is the WhatsApp number advertised on the page — it was not supplied by the audit and not invented.

entries.title: يونت Roson R2 Pro
entries.body: Dental Hub بتوفّر يونت أسنان موديل Roson R2 Pro. للمواصفات الكاملة والسعر والتوفر، التواصل على الواتساب.
entries.sourceCells: Content Performance — the client's own post caption naming the model.
entries.evidence: Existence of the product line only. The caption's own claims — 'الوكيل الحصري والمعتمد' and 'الأكثر مبيعًا في مصر' — are deliberately NOT carried into this entry: they are the client's marketing assertions, not audit findings, and exclusive-agency and best-selling claims are substantiable statements. They are held in knowledge.draft.json.

entries.title: جهاز تعقيم Fomos Autoclave
entries.body: Dental Hub بتوفّر جهاز تعقيم Fomos Autoclave. للمواصفات الكاملة والسعر والتوفر، التواصل على الواتساب.
entries.sourceCells: Issues & Complaints §B — one active ad in Meta Ad Library since 2026-08-11.
entries.evidence: Existence of the product line only. The '20 ألف خصم' seen in the ad creative is NOT included: an OFFER with no end date cannot be approved, and the database constraint knowledge_commercial_requires_expiry would refuse it. It is held in knowledge.draft.json until Dental Hub states the expiry.

entries.title: باكدچ تجهيز عيادة كاملة
entries.body: Dental Hub بتقدّم خدمة تجهيز عيادة كاملة. تفاصيل الباكدچ والأسعار بتختلف حسب عدد الكراسي ومساحة العيادة — التواصل على الواتساب لتحديد المناسب.
entries.sourceCells: Content Performance — the clinic-package post, highest comment rate in the fully-recorded sample; Product Demand evidence column.
entries.evidence: Existence of the service only. The audit's own reply draft RL-08 quotes a price range from '[سعر]' to '[سعر]' — both placeholders. No price band is asserted here.
